SERIES A TERM SHEET
ACMECORP INC.

Investment Amount:    $5,000,000
Pre-Money Valuation:  $20,000,000
Post-Money Valuation: $25,000,000
Lead Investor:        Foobar Ventures LP

LIQUIDATION PREFERENCE: 1x non-participating

EXCLUSIVITY / NO-SHOP. During a period of  days following the date hereof,
the Company shall not, without the consent of the Lead Investor, directly
or indirectly solicit, initiate, encourage or assist the submission of any
proposal regarding a sale of any of the equity securities of the Company.

Standard provisions for closing, board composition, anti-dilution, drag-along,
ROFR, co-sale, information rights, registration rights, and conditions to
closing apply, as set forth in the long-form definitive documents to be
mutually agreed by counsel. This Term Sheet is non-binding except as to
exclusivity and confidentiality. Counsel: Foobar & Associates LLP.
